what: Merged PR #19 by hand with an explicit squash message: GitHub's auto-merge appends a Co-authored-by paragraph after the PR body, which hides Athena-Job trailers from the history check (the likely cause of main going red after #14).
why: A PR that adds records but closes no job needs trailers as the squash's last paragraph; nothing in Athena lands PRs yet, so the operator had to.
